author: Mr FreeMan / Tonnel Network
description: Price prediction rounds with oracle-signed prices. Source code reconstructed by @ai_terminal.

declarations.name: SubmitPrice

fields.name: roundTs
fields.description: The round start time. It must be a multiple of `roundDuration`.

fields.name: price
fields.description: The oracle price. It must not be 0.

fields.name: signature
fields.description: The 512-bit Ed25519 signature of `PricePayload`, with no refs.

declarations.description:
Anyone → contract: the signed oracle price at the start of a round.
The price opens this round and closes the previous round.

declarations.name: ProcessPayouts
declarations.description:
Contract → contract: pays the next batch of bettors of a closed round.
Any sender can send it.

declarations.name: ForceRefund
declarations.description: Anyone → contract: refunds a round that has no result after the refund delay.

declarations.name: WithdrawFees
declarations.description: Treasury → contract: withdraws all protocol fees.

declarations.name: UpdateOracleAndConfig
declarations.description:
Admin → contract: sets a new oracle key and a new configuration.
The contract must have no active rounds, no locked funds and no bettors.

declarations.name: TextComment
declarations.description: The body of an outgoing payment: op 0 and a ref to the comment text.

declarations.name: Bet

fields.name: long
fields.description: The amount on "the price goes up".

fields.name: short
fields.description: The amount on "the price goes down".

declarations.description: The bet of one bettor in one round. A bettor bets on one side only.

declarations.name: Round

fields.name: openPrice
fields.description: The oracle price at the round start. 0: no price.

fields.name: closePrice
fields.description: The oracle price at the round end. 0: no price.

fields.name: longPool
fields.description: The sum of all "Long" bets.

fields.name: shortPool
fields.description: The sum of all "Short" bets.

fields.name: unpaidPool
fields.description: The amount that is not paid out yet. After the last payout, it goes to the protocol fees.

fields.name: unpaidBettorCount
fields.description: The number of bettors that are not paid out yet.

fields.name: result
fields.description: One of the `RESULT_*` values.

fields.name: bets
fields.description: The bets that are not paid out yet, by bettor address.

declarations.description: One prediction round. The key in the rounds map is the round start time.

declarations.name: Config

fields.name: roundDuration
fields.description: The round length, in seconds.

fields.name: feeBps
fields.description: The protocol fee, in basis points of the losing pool.

fields.name: betFee
fields.description: The amount that the contract keeps from each bet message.

fields.name: minOpValue
fields.description:
The minimum value of an operation message. The contract also attaches this value
to each `ProcessPayouts` message that it sends to itself.

fields.name: reserveExtra
fields.description: The balance that the contract keeps in addition to the locked funds and the protocol fees.

fields.name: priceWindow
fields.description: The time after the round start in which the oracle can send the price, in seconds.

fields.name: refundDelay
fields.description: The time after the round end after which any sender can refund the round, in seconds.

fields.name: maxBettorsPerRound
fields.description: The maximum number of bettors in one round.

fields.name: maxActiveRounds
fields.description: The maximum number of rounds that are not fully paid out.

fields.name: payoutBatchSize
fields.description: The maximum number of payouts in one transaction.

fields.name: betSize1
fields.description: The permitted bet sizes, from the smallest to the largest.

fields.name: treasury
fields.description: The address that gets the protocol fees.

declarations.description: The contract settings. The admin changes them with `UpdateOracleAndConfig`.

declarations.name: Storage

fields.name: networkId
fields.description: The global ID of the network (-239: mainnet, -3: testnet). It is part of the signed price.

fields.name: oraclePublicKey
fields.description: The public key of the price oracle.

fields.name: lastRoundTs
fields.description: The start time of the last round that got a price.

fields.name: lastPrice
fields.description: The last price from the oracle.

fields.name: lockedFunds
fields.description: The sum of the bets that are not paid out yet.

fields.name: protocolFees
fields.description: The protocol fees that are not withdrawn yet.

fields.name: activeRoundCount
fields.description: The number of rounds that are not fully paid out.

fields.name: rounds
fields.description: The rounds, by round start time.

fields.name: openBetCounts
fields.description:
The number of open bets of each bettor, by bettor address. A bettor can have one bet
in each round.

fields.name: config
fields.description: The contract settings.

declarations.description: The contract data. The field order and the field sizes are the same as in the deployed contract.

get_methods.name: get_state
get_methods.description: Returns the full contract data cell.

get_methods.name: get_config
get_methods.description: Returns the admin address, the oracle public key and the configuration cell.

get_methods.name: get_round
get_methods.description: Returns the round cell for a round start time. Returns null if the round is not found.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidBetText
thrown_errors.description: The text bet is not "Long" or "Short", or the body has refs.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.NotEnoughValue
thrown_errors.description: The message value is less than `minOpValue`.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.SenderNotAllowed
thrown_errors.description:
The sender cannot do this operation. For a bet: the sender is not in the basechain,
or it is the contract itself.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidBetAmount
thrown_errors.description: The message value minus `betFee` is not one of the permitted bet sizes.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.RoundNotFound
thrown_errors.description: The round is not in the rounds map.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidRoundState
thrown_errors.description: The round state does not permit this operation.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidRoundTime
thrown_errors.description: The round time is not correct for a price update.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidPriceProof
thrown_errors.description: The price is 0, or the oracle signature is not correct.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.LimitReached
thrown_errors.description: The limit of active rounds, or the limit of bettors in the round, is reached.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.NoFees
thrown_errors.description: There are no protocol fees to withdraw.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.RefundTooEarly
thrown_errors.description: The refund delay of the round is not complete.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.ContractNotIdle
thrown_errors.description: The contract has active rounds, locked funds or bettors.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidConfig
thrown_errors.description: A value in the new configuration, or the new oracle key, is not correct.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.TreasuryChangeWithFees
thrown_errors.description: The treasury cannot change while there are protocol fees to withdraw.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.BettorNotFound
thrown_errors.description: A paid bettor is not in the open bet counts map.
